text: I went here for wisdom teeth extraction. The dentist lady was very gentle and was able to remove 2 teeth on the same day. I did not have much pain or swelling afterwards. I also did cleaning another time and the service was great. The price was good as well, so I definitely recommend this clinic to my friends.

Had a great experience getting my teeth cleaning here. The dentist found a cavity during my check up and was efficiently fixed. The dentist and staff spoke English well, explaining everything thoroughly. Very happy with the reasonable prices

Very good place! I moved here from the US and was recommended this place. My dentist was a guy and he was nice, polite, and gentle with the cleaning. I felt comfortable and he explained my teeth health. I recommend coming as the prices were very affordable with good service. Thank you! Will come again.

Healthy Smile Dental Clinic is great, I live in Bangkok, and this has become my favorite dentist. I had a wisdom tooth removed, 3 fillings, and a clean. This place is much cheaper than nearby places and they have both male and female dentists. They feel a lot more friendly than some of the other places and speak good English. But the prices are impressive, for this area they are very cheap. This is the place I will go to in the future, and they are only about 30 seconds walk from the Thong Lor BTS, making them one of the easiest places to get to. A few doors down is the new Porsche coffee shop, so you can wait there or go there afterward. It's a great place to check out on your trip to the dentist. I feel this is a great place for foreigners to go because they are friendly and they explain in great detail what your issues may be. Give them a try.

My first dentist experience in Thailand. What an awesome place.  I didn’t have to wait for my appointment date, I showed up early and was seen right away.  Cleaning performed by the dentist. Happy I found my dentist (and he speaks perfect English).

Had a regular scaling and polishing here and am very impressed by the professional service rendered. Teeth were cleaned meticulously and with great care. Would recommend to anyone looking for routine cleaning.
Easy access by BTS, very skillful dentists, great communication. Can use Thai social security dental benefits here. Highly recommended.

Not only did he accommodate my sudden appointment, the doctor was also very skillful and solved my tooth pain in about 10 minutes at a cheap price without pain.
Thank you so much!!

Amazing service & a great deal too.
My dad went to fix his tooth and it was very impressive the price is affordable, the clinic is clean and perfect
I made an appointment and had the free check up. I then needed a filling and a clean. All done in an hour with no trouble. I will use again.
Highly recommend this clinic, dentist very patience and professional. Check and explain everything in detail, price is very reasonable.
Professional dentist with reasonable price, The place may not look fancy like other dental clinic in this area but good service and professional.
very nice staff. I did cleaning and removed one wisdom teeth with no pain at all.
very good experience 🙏🏾 …

Nice and thorough teeth cleaning

Went for a cleaning and scaling. The doctor was very professional and spoke good english. Prices were also very reasonable.

Highly recommend!
After being misdiagnosed at another clinic, he provided a detailed consultation. Despite the unassuming facade, the doctor is a super expert in his field. I highly recommend him.
The dentist is lovely, kind, and very gentle when scaling teeth. The price is affordable, and it's easy to get there.

The doctor is excellent! I had my wisdom tooth extracted here. I was trying to find a clinic in Bangkok close to my dorm and finally found this one. Since then, I've been getting all my dental work done here.

I can wholeheartedly recommend this place. Thai and non-Thai patients are treated equally here. The prices are transparent and very fair. And the dentists are very empathetic, professional, and conscientious. Both dentists also spoke excellent English.

I've rarely felt comfortable at other dental clinics, and the prices they charged were far too high, even by German standards.

So, if you want white and healthy teeth, definitely go there.

Today I came for teeth cleaning and filling 🦷 I was very impressed. The dentist was kind and explained everything during the procedure (I really liked that). The atmosphere was warm and friendly. I plan to make this my regular clinic ❤

💵 The price was also reasonable.

The doctor was very polite and provided excellent information, allowing us to make our own decisions. The doctor was very friendly, and the price was reasonable. With social security insurance, there's no need to pay upfront; they handle everything. I highly recommend this clinic.

I went in for a filling. The dentist was very gentle and patient.
He was extremely thorough. The assistant was lovely, polite, and friendly. Plus, I was covered by social security. It was a one-stop shop.
I'll definitely go again.
Her hands were so soft, she paid attention to every detail. The doctor was incredibly kind and lovely.
